target_customer: Specialty crop farmers, buyers and agriculture professionals, mainly grape and almond growers in California and Australia
problem: Farmers forecast yield with pencil and paper, so production predictions had a large error rate and supply chain waste followed.
business_model: B2B SaaS forecasts and analytics subscriptions

founders.name: Megan Nunes
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page.

founders.name: Michael Bertino
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in a search summary of Crunchbase; not seen on the YC page. Crunchbase profile lists him as co-founder (seen via search summary, https://crunchbase.com/organization/bountiful-e579).

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining machine learning with weather, satellite and historical data into crop forecasts needed real data science for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated yield data could compound, but the niche was small and forecasting methods were not exclusive.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed or bought it in sources found; the company still operated in 2026.

market_need_then: The company states that grape production forecasts had a roughly 30 percent error rate in 2015 because many farmers used manual methods.

branding.domain_note: Uses bountiful.ag; earlier product site was vinsight.co.

identity.logo: New logo and color scheme introduced at the rebrand from Vinsight
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, farmer oriented analytics posts on Medium

rebrands.why: Announced on Medium with a new logo, color and features as the product widened beyond grapes; exact date not seen.

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly real word name that helped broaden beyond wine, but a generic term with little press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Bountiful began as Vinsight with grape harvest forecasts, joined YC in Winter 2017 and later broadened to almonds and a marketplace and operating system. It is still operating in 2026 with a four person team listed, but sources show only small seed funding and no clear breakout.
notes: Funding unverified: one profile says 1.4M seed in March 2017 led by Y Combinator, CB Insights says 1.64M across five rounds including a 0.15M accelerator round in June 2024 from Google for Startups Founders Funds, other sites list 4.6M. Each was seen only in snippets or aggregators, so no round is recorded. The Medium rebrand post could not be fetched.
